company.name: Relari
company.shortDescription: Relari helps AI teams rigorously test, validate and improve GenAI applications throughout the entire development lifecycle.
company.description: Relari is the creator of continuous eval, a modular evaluation framework that uses open-source technology to cover a wide range of applications such as text generation, code generation, retrieval, classification, agents, and other LLM use cases. The cloud-based platform generates custom synthetic data to simulate user behavior and stress test GenAI applications.

productsAndServices.description: A contract-driven development toolkit that uses natural language to define, verify, and certify AI agent behavior across critical scenarios.
productsAndServices.name: Agent Contracts

productsAndServices.description: Metrics and evaluation tools tailored to specific AI applications to measure and optimize agent performance using a combination of deterministic and LLM-based methods.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Evaluators

productsAndServices.description: A simulation environment that tests AI agents by running them through thousands of synthetic scenarios to validate behavior and identify issues.
productsAndServices.name: Agent Simulation

productsAndServices.description: Automatically generated test cases that simulate diverse scenarios to rigorously evaluate AI agent behavior and performance.
productsAndServices.name: Synthetic Test Cases

productsAndServices.description: Analytical tools that provide detailed insights into AI agent execution traces to help identify and fix issues during development.
productsAndServices.name: Trace Analytics
